title: No README.md with setup and run instructions
evidence: run_dir has no README.md — `find . -iname '*readme*'` returns nothing; only TASK.md and FEEDBACK.md are present. FEEDBACK.md line 16 lists [R11] as a required deliverable for this repair task.

title: Orphan source files src/routes.rs and src/schema.rs are not part of the crate
evidence: src/main.rs declares no `mod routes;`/`mod schema;`, so routes.rs (references nonexistent `crate::handlers`, main.rs:3) and schema.rs are dead files; the crate compiles only because they are unreferenced.
suggestion: Delete the orphan files or wire them in as real modules; routes.rs would not compile if included as-is.
